### A Eulogy for My Father

"Good morning/afternoon everyone.

Thank you all for being here to remember my father. It is a strange and heavy thing to stand here today. For most of my life, the word 'father' was associated with fear, silence, and the sound of a bottle being opened. But today, I am here to speak about the man who was my father, not just the man who hurt me.

My father was a man of contradictions. To the world, he may have been a neighbor, a worker, or a family member. But to me, and to my siblings, he was a source of terror. For most of my childhood, our home was not a place of safety, but a place where we had to walk on eggshells. He drank heavily, and that drink turned him into someone we didn't recognize. He hit us. He broke things. He broke us.

It is difficult to find the words to describe a father who was also a monster. But I am standing here today because my aunt asked me to, and because I believe that even in the most broken stories, there is a need for closure.

I will not lie to you and tell you that he was a good man. I will not pretend that the scars he left on us are gone. Those scars are part of me, and they are part of my siblings. We survived him. We survived the drinking, the violence, and the fear. And in surviving him, we found a strength that he never had.

And we are still learning how to love, and how to be safe, without him.

Rest in peace, Dad. You are finally at rest, and so are we."
